ProgramUnit.Name: INSERT_NOTE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure insert_note is
 note_exist boolean;
begin
 note_exist := true;
 begin
 select 'x' into :global.x from note_books
 where note_id = :batch_inputs.note_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 note_exist := false;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if note_exist then
 begin
 update note_books
 set note = :s_note
 where note_id = :note_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 begin
 select notebook_seq.nextval
 into :batch_inputs.note_id
 from dual;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 insert into note_books
 (note_id,note)
 values (:batch_inputs.note_id, :s_note);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_INTERDICTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure check_interdiction is
 temp_count number;
 temp_coll_date date;
 temp_inter_code VARCHAR2(4);
 temp_max_temp number(5,2);
 temp_min_temp number(5,2);
 temp_count1 number;
 cursor c1 is
 select product_code
 from components
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 coll_date = :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code != 'NONE' and
 component_status = 'L';
begin
 --
 -- TEMP interdiction
 --
 begin
 select count(*)
 into temp_count
 from unit_interdictions
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 coll_date = :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 inter_code in (select inter_code
 from valid_interdictions_lab
 where system_inter_code = 'TEMP'
 and sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365));
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if temp_count >= 1
 then
 if :batch_inputs.max_temp <= 37.5
 then
 -- interdiction 'TEMP' is no more required
 begin
 delete from unit_interdictions
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 coll_date = :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date and
 inter_code in (select inter_code
 from valid_interdictions_lab
 where system_inter_code = 'TEMP'
 and sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365));
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 elsif temp_count = 0
 then
 if :batch_inputs.max_temp > 37.5
 then
 -- interdiction 'TEMP' has to be created for
 -- the unit
 :GLOBAL.return_val := sbclib.unit_system_interdiction (
 :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date ,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 'TEMP',:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if :GLOBAL.return_val != '0'
 then
 message('Interdictions TEMP not assigned to unit');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
 --
 -- CMT interdiction
 --
 begin
-- In case of import batch, temperatures should be checked against
-- MIN_RCV_TEMP & MAX_RCV_TEMP
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 begin
 select
 decode(:contract_type,'IM',nvl(max_rcv_temp,:max_temp),
 max_temp),
 decode(:contract_type,'IM',nvl(min_rcv_temp,:min_temp),
 min_temp)
 into temp_max_temp, temp_min_temp
 from valid_products
 where product_code = substr(c1_rec.product_code,1,5);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
/* message('Product: '||c1_rec.product_code);
 message('Min Temp: '||to_char(temp_min_temp));
 message('Max Temp: '||to_char(temp_max_temp)); */
 begin
 select count(*)
 into temp_count
 from component_interdictions
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 coll_date = :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code = c1_rec.product_code and
 inter_code in (select inter_code
 from valid_interdictions_lab
 where system_inter_code = 'CMT'
 and sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365));
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if temp_count >= 1
 then
-- message('CMT interdiction found');
 if :batch_inputs.max_temp <= temp_max_temp and
 :batch_inputs.min_temp >= temp_min_temp
 then
-- message('Interdiction CMT is no more required');
 begin
 delete from component_interdictions
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 coll_date = :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date and
 product_code = c1_rec.product_code and
 inter_code in (select inter_code
 from valid_interdictions_lab
 where system_inter_code = 'CMT'
 and sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365));
 
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 elsif temp_count = 0
 then
-- message('Interdiction CMT not present');
 if :batch_inputs.max_temp > temp_max_temp or
 :batch_inputs.min_temp < temp_min_temp
 then
-- message('Interdiction CMT to be added');
 :GLOBAL.return_val := sbclib.comp_system_interdiction (
 :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date ,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 c1_rec.product_code,
 'CMT',:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if :GLOBAL.return_val != '0'
 then
-- message('Interdiction CMT not assigned to unit');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
 end loop;
 
 --- Added for IM 8143 --tmppp 
 begin
 select count(*)
 into temp_count1
 from unit_interdictions
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 coll_date = :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 inter_code in (select inter_code
 from valid_interdictions_lab
 where system_inter_code = 'CMT'
 and sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365));
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if temp_count1 >= 1
 then
 
 begin
 delete from unit_interdictions
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 coll_date = :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date and
 inter_code in (select inter_code
 from valid_interdictions_lab
 where system_inter_code = 'CMT'
 and sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365));
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then

 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 --- ended for IM 8143 
 end;
end;
